newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares fall in lower turnover.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares fall in lower turnover.

text.p: 1220 GMT - Polish shares fell in lower turnover after a three-session rise and selling was stronger after price fixing.
* The main market's WIG index fell 83.9 points, or 0.6 percent, to 13,659.9, the WIG 20 fell 0.9 percent to 1,387.4 and the parallel market's WIRR rose 1.8 percent to 2,569.4.

* Turnover fell 11.8 percent to 70.4 million zlotys on both markets as 40 issues fell, 25 rose and 18 were flat. Sell offers for nine stocks and buy orders for six were unmatched. Most active Bank Slaski was flat in a 5.9-million- zloty turnover. NFI units fell 5.2 percent in 27-million-zloty trade. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
